thesis: The speaker argues that many people stop learning after finishing school, effectively becoming 'living corpses' between ages 25 and 75, whereas Charles T. Munger remains a 'learning machine' by reading approximately 500 books a year for decades. Additionally, the speaker highlights Munger's use of mental models and his practice of minimizing time spent with low-quality individuals to ensure he continues to become better.
